# Data Cleaning
merge prep:
```{r}
## merge....prep?
### give participants a unique ID
cohortp <- cohort %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(10:11)) %>% 
  mutate(record_id = as.numeric(str_sub(PPID, 1, 6)),
         Enrolm_Date = mdy(Enrolm_Date),
         Exit_Date = ifelse(E3_Date == "#N/A", "12/31/2023", E3_Date),
         Exit_Date = mdy(Exit_Date)) %>% 
  relocate(record_id, .after = PPID)
rn2p <- rn2 %>% 
  # remove REDCap stuff
  dplyr::select(-c(redcap_event_name, redcap_repeat_instrument,
            redcap_repeat_instance)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(rn2_pt_id) & rn2_cnst_n2 == 1) %>% 
  mutate(PPID = paste0(record_id, LETTERS[rn2_pt_id])) %>% 
  relocate(PPID)
armsp <- arms %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(redcap_event_name, redcap_repeat_instrument,
            redcap_repeat_instance)) %>% 
  mutate(PPID = paste0(record_id, LETTERS[a_pt_id])) %>% 
  relocate(PPID)

### ok these also depend on year
actsp <- actsurv %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(redcap_event_name, redcap_repeat_instrument,
            redcap_repeat_instance, var6_no)) %>% 
  mutate(PPID = paste0(record_id, LETTERS[var6_pt_id])) %>% 
  relocate(PPID) %>% 
  mutate(evnt_year = year(mdy(var6_rpt_date))) %>% 
  relocate(evnt_year, .after = record_id) # %>% 

### by house, not by participant
### so just get rid of redcap names
so1p <- so1 %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(redcap_event_name, redcap_repeat_instrument, 
            redcap_repeat_instance))

## subset of main population, also for different endpoint (infection) ?
serop <- sero %>% ## ok want to figure out how to add this - to main dataset?
  dplyr::select(-c(redcap_event_name, redcap_repeat_instrument,
            redcap_repeat_instance)) %>% 
  mutate(PPID = paste0(record_id, LETTERS[ss_pt_id])) %>% 
  relocate(PPID)

## by house and visit
### check to see if they were still enrolled?
entof <- ento %>% 
  group_by(record_id, timepoint) %>% 
  # tirs arm nonzero coverage for each visit
  summarize(all_visits = all(coverage != 0),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  group_by(record_id) %>% 
  # true for all years in study?
  summarize(per_protocol = as.integer(all(all_visits)),
            .groups = "drop") 
entop <- ento %>% 
  left_join(entof, by = "record_id") %>% 
  mutate(per_protocol = ifelse(block_type == 1, per_protocol, 0),
         per_protocol = ifelse(arm == 0, 1, per_protocol)) %>% 
  # just take first per house?
  group_by(record_id) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-block_type)
```

merge together:
```{r}
## big merge??? and try to fill in some missing data?
full <- cohortp %>% 
  full_join(actsp, by = c("PPID", "record_id")) %>% # event year + id + house
  relocate(c(Enrolm_Date, Exit_Date, evnt_year), .after = record_id) %>% 
  full_join(rn2p, by = c("PPID", "record_id")) %>% # id + house
  full_join(armsp, by = c("PPID", "record_id")) %>% 
  full_join(so1p, by = "record_id") %>% # house
  full_join(entop, by = "record_id") %>% # house
  rename(Pos_All = var6_abv_pos___1,
         trial_arm = a_arm,
         block_type = a_block) %>% 
  relocate(c(Pos_All, trial_arm, block_type), .after = evnt_year) %>%
  # fix trial arm assignment
  mutate(cluster = str_sub(PPID, 1, 2)) %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% 
  mutate(arm = first(trial_arm[!is.na(trial_arm)])) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

function to calculate person-time since we're only looking at active 
surveillance during peak ABD season (July 1 - December 31)
```{r}
person_time <- function(time1, time2) {
  # start and end dates for active ABD seasons
  season_start <- mdy(c("07/01/2021", "07/01/2022", "07/01/2023"))
  season_end <- mdy(c("12/31/2021", "12/31/2022", "12/31/2023"))
  
  # initialize vector to hold total person-time for each individual
  total <- rep(0, length(time1))
  
  for (i in seq_along(season_start)){
    # each person's entry and exit per season
    entry <- pmax(time1, season_start[i])
    exit <- pmin(time2, season_end[i])
    
    time_in_season <- ifelse(time2 > season_start[i] & time1<= season_end[i],
                             as.numeric(exit - entry), 0)
    total <- total + time_in_season
  }
  
  return(total)
}
```

formatting and cleaning full datset to use for analysis:
```{r}
data$active_complete <- ifelse(data$Pos_All != 1, 1, 
       ifelse(data$var6_active_surveillance_results_complete == 2, 1,  0))

# want one line per person, include all their person-time (only active period)
data <- full %>% 
  # only those with positive events and have complete results???
  # filter(active_complete == 1) %>% 
  # # only take first event/one line per id
  group_by(PPID) %>% 
  filter(row_number() == {
    event <- which(Pos_All==1)
    if(length(which(Pos_All==1)) > 0) {
      event[1]
    } else {
      1
    }
  }) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  # if pos_all == 0 did not experience event -- censored 
  mutate(Pos_All = ifelse(is.na(Pos_All), 0, Pos_All),
         Symp_Date = mdy(var6_symp_date),
         Time2 = if_else(Pos_All == 1 & Symp_Date < Exit_Date, Symp_Date,
                        Exit_Date)) %>% 
  relocate(c(Symp_Date, Time2), .after = Exit_Date) %>%
  # 22 had missing enrollment/exit dates...drop?
  filter(!is.na(Enrolm_Date)) %>% 
  # calculating person-time in days
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(entry = 0,
         exit = person_time(Enrolm_Date, Time2)) %>% 
  relocate(c(entry, exit), .after = record_id) %>% 
  # only including those who contributed person time
  filter(exit != 0)
  # omg 4461 children same as in paper yay
```

# Following Main Analysis
Table 1 Cumulative Incidence
```{r}
# intent to treat
## check people and events
### tirs 2239, check ; ABD cases 198 check :)
itt_tirs <- data %>% 
  filter(arm == 1) %>% 
  filter(Pos_All == 1)
### control arm = 2222, check ; 199 ABD cases check
itt_ctrl <- data %>% 
  filter(arm == 0) %>% 
  filter(Pos_All == 1)

## cumulative incidence
itt.km <- survfit(Surv(entry, exit, Pos_All) ~ arm, data = data)
ggsurvplot(itt.km, data = data, fun = "event", conf.int = TRUE)
s <- summary(itt.km)

estimates <- data.frame(
  time = s$time,
  arm = s$strata,
  surv = s$surv,
  lower = s$lower,
  upper = s$upper,
  cuminc = 1 - s$surv,
  cuminc_lower = 1 - s$upper,
  cuminc_upper = 1 - s$lower
)

estimates %>% 
  group_by(arm) %>% 
  filter(time == max(time)) %>% 
  select(arm, time, cuminc, cuminc_lower, cuminc_upper)


## try diff way?
# clustering for robust standard errors?
itt.cox <- coxph(Surv(entry, exit, Pos_All) ~ arm + cluster(cluster),
                      data = data)
# km estimate from cox model
itt.km_cluster <- survfit(itt.cox, newdata = data.frame(arm = c(0, 1)))
          ## ok not the best way i think but for what i need it for prob fine?
ggsurvplot(itt.km_cluster, fun = "event", data = data)
s_cluster <- summary(itt.km_cluster)

cluster <- data.frame(
  time = s_cluster$time,
  surv = s_cluster$surv,
  lower = s_cluster$lower,
  upper = s_cluster$upper,
  cuminc = 1 - s_cluster$surv,
  cuminc_lower = 1 - s_cluster$upper,
  cuminc_upper = 1 - s_cluster$lower
)
cluster <- cluster %>% 
  rename(control_cum_inc = cuminc.1,
         tirs_cum_inc = cuminc.2,
         control_lower = cuminc_lower.1,
         control_upper = cuminc_upper.1,
         tirs_lower = cuminc_lower.2,
         tirs_upper = cuminc_upper.2) %>% 
  relocate(c(control_cum_inc, control_lower, control_upper, tirs_cum_inc, 
             tirs_lower, tirs_upper), .after = time)

cluster[nrow(cluster),]
```
Table 1 TIRS efficacy
```{r}
summary(itt.cox)
# efficacy estimated as 1 - unadjusted cox hazard ratio: 3.9%
1 - exp(coef(itt.cox))
# in paper: -28.1% - 26.7%, using permutation-based CI
1 - exp(confint(itt.cox))
```
